oneSourceByteChange.note: Only shards whose own primary text or read-only context covers the mutated byte change hash; every other shard's result stays reusable by hash.

frozenInventoryHashChange.note: The frozen inventory identity is part of every shard hash, so a Pass A change invalidates every shard - no partial reuse.
